findings.title: No re-check of cache after acquiring write lock
findings.body: After the RLock is released and the write Lock is taken, the cache is not checked again. When the cache is cold in non-dev mode, N concurrent callers all pass the nil check and then serialize on the write lock. Each one re-reads the manifest file and rebuilds the assets, and each one overwrites the cache. Add a double-checked `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return ... }` after Lock().

findings.title: Cache is overwritten even when loading fails
findings.body: `entryPointAssetsCache = result` runs unconditionally. If the read fails, result is nil and the cache is set to nil, which discards a previously good value. This is mainly a problem in dev mode. The error is still returned alongside a nil pointer. Only assign the cache when err == nil.
